entry.name: rnbo_send~
entry.description: send~ will transmit signals to receive~ objects that share the same name argument, providing the ability to send signals within a RNBO patcher and its subpatchers without using patch cords. Note: send~ will not transmit messages between a RNBO patcher and its root-level Max patch.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name of theobject. Allobjects that share the same name will receive data from aobject with that name. Note that unlike, creating multipleobjects with the same name will result in a compilation error from the RNBO patch.
